text.p: Pen pictures of players expected to make up the Feyenoord squad for Sunday's Dutch first division match against PSV Eindhoven:
Ed de Goey. Goalkeeper. Age 29. Unspectacular but reliable. Won 27 Dutch caps before Ajax's Edwin van der Sar displaced him.
Clemens Zwijnenberg. Right-back. Age 26. Stand-in for suspended George Boateng. Stocky and fast, but has yet to command a regular first-team place.

Geoffrey Claeys. Central defender. Age 22. Belgian international. Bought in the summer to replace Ronald Koeman who is expected to retire at the end of the season. However, has so far failed to convince that he is ready for the task.
George Boateng. defender. Age 21. Born in Ghana, but plays for the Dutch youth team. Strong and fast defender and reliable marker. Was sent off during the away match against PSV.

Ronald Koeman. Libero. Age 33. The Feyenoord skipper's passing skills and free-kick prowess are well known. His reading of the game and organisation of the defence easily make up for a lack of pace. Won 78 caps for the Dutch national team and plans to retire at the end of this season.
Bernard Schuiteman. Defender. Age 23. Expected to replace suspended left-back Patricio Graff. Began his career with German first division side Bayer Leverkuesen.

Kees van Wonderen. Midfielder. Age 27. Joined Feyenoord in the summer from NAC Breda and has become a valuable midfield asset. Scored twice on his debut in Europe, the UEFA Cup first round tie against CSKA Moscow.
Pablo Sanchez. Striker. Age 23. The Argentine striker was another close season buy. Beginning to settle in the Dutch league but still mixes brilliance with mediocrity.
Giovanni van Bronckhorst. Midfield. Age 21. Has caught the eye of national coach Guus Hiddink, winning two caps this season. Multi-functional left-sided player.

Gaston Taument. Right winger. Age 26. His speed and dribbling on the right flank have given many opponents problems and won him 16 international caps. However, has signed a four year contract to play for Benfica from next season.

Henryk Larsson. Striker. Age 25. Regular front man for Sweden, the blond, dreadlocked striker is the Rotterdam club's top scorer, but only with five league goals. His modest height belies his danger in the air. Excellent timing.
Henk Vos. Striker. Age 28. The robust forward lacks finesse, but is a proven goal-scorer. Suspect temperament.
Henk Fraser. Central defender. Age 30. Hard man at the heart of the defence, but often injured.
Tomek Iwan. Midfielder. Age 24. Joined from Roda JC at the beginning of last season in a complex transfer deal that required legal mediation. Has yet to command a regular first-team place.
Tati Montoya. Striker. Age 20. The Argentine joined the club during the winter break.
Fernando Picun. Defender. Age 24. The Uruguayan came at the same time as Montoya.
